description.raw: '''Passive:''' '''Olaf''' gains [[File:Armor icon.svg|15px|link=Armor]] '''bonus''' armor and [[File:Magic resistance icon.svg|15px|link=Magic resistance]] '''bonus''' magic resistance.
description.text: Passive: Olaf gains  bonus armor and  bonus magic resistance.

description2.raw: '''Active:''' '''Olaf''' becomes enraged for 3 seconds, [[File:Remove Scurvy.png|20px|link=Crowd control#Removal|An icon representing the keyword Cleanse]] [[:Crowd control#Removal|cleansing]] himself of all [[File:Stun icon.png|20px|link=Crowd control|An icon representing the keyword Crowd control]] [[:Crowd control|crowd control]] and becoming [[File:Cc-immune_icon.png|20px|link=Crowd control#Immunity|An icon representing the keyword Cc-Immune]] [[:Crowd control#Immunity|immune to them]], as well as gaining [[File:Attack damage icon.svg|15px|link=Attack damage]] '''bonus''' attack damage and 10% increased [[size]]. For the first second of ''Ragnarok'', he also gains [[File:Movement speed icon.png|15px|link=Movement speed]] '''bonus''' movement speed while facing [[File:Sight icon.png|20px|link=Sight|An icon representing the keyword Sight]] [[:Sight|visible]] enemy [[File:Champion icon.png|20px|link=Champion|An icon representing the keyword Champion]] [[:Champion|champions]] within 2000 units.
description2.text: Active: Olaf becomes enraged for 3 seconds, cleansing himself of all crowd control and becoming immune to them, as well as gaining  bonus attack damage and 10% increased size. For the first second of Ragnarok, he also gains  bonus movement speed while facing visible enemy champions within 2000 units.

description3.raw: ''Ragnarok's'' duration is increased by and up to 2.5 seconds for each basic attack [[File:On-hit icon.png|20px|link=Attack_effects#On_Hitting|An icon representing the keyword On-hit]] [[:Attack_effects#On_Hitting|on-hit]] or cast of ''[[File:Olaf Reckless Swing.png|20xpx|border|link=Olaf#Reckless Swing|An icon for Olaf's ability Reckless Swing]] [[Olaf#Reckless Swing|Reckless Swing]]'' against an enemy [[File:Champion icon.png|20px|link=Champion|An icon representing the keyword Champion]] [[:Champion|champion]].
description3.text: Ragnarok's duration is increased by and up to 2.5 seconds for each basic attack on-hit or cast of Reckless Swing against an enemy champion.

notes.raw: * ''Ragnarok'' removes the underlying [[File:Stun icon.png|20px|link=Stun|An icon representing the keyword Stun]] [[:Stun|stun]] from [[File:Airborne icon.png|20px|link=Airborne|An icon representing the keyword Airborne]] [[:Airborne|airborne]] effects, but not the forced displacement, which requires him to use a [[File:Flash.png|20px|link=Blink|An icon representing the keyword Blink]] [[:Blink|blink]] or [[File:Dash.png|20px|link=Dash|An icon representing the keyword Dash]] [[:Dash|dash]] ability to override it. * ''Ragnarok'' does not negate any [[debuff]]s other than [[File:Stun icon.png|20px|link=Crowd control|An icon representing the keyword Crowd control]] [[:Crowd control|crowd control]] from being applied unless absolutely necessary. * The '''bonus''' attack damage updates dynamically over the duration; Increases or reductions in attack damage after the effect has been applied will still be amplified. * The 25% attack damage scaling amplifies the flat attack damage '''bonus''' as well. * ''Ragnarok'' will not expire during [[File:Olaf Reckless Swing.png|20xpx|border|link=Olaf#Reckless Swing|An icon for Olaf's ability Reckless Swing]] [[Olaf#Reckless Swing|Reckless Swing's]] cast time. * ''Ragnarok's'' duration will not be increased if the basic attack is [[File:Jax Counter Strike old.png|20px|link=Attack_effects#Parrying|An icon representing the keyword Dodge]] [[:Attack_effects#Parrying|dodged]]. * ''Ragnarok's'' duration will be increased if the basic attack is [[File:Spirit's Refuge.png|20px|link=Attack_effects#Parrying|An icon representing the keyword Block]] [[:Attack_effects#Parrying|blocked]].
notes.text:
Ragnarok removes the underlying stun from airborne effects, but not the forced displacement, which requires him to use a blink or dash ability to override it.
Ragnarok does not negate any debuffs other than crowd control from being applied unless absolutely necessary.
The bonus attack damage updates dynamically over the duration; Increases or reductions in attack damage after the effect has been applied will still be amplified.
The 25% attack damage scaling amplifies the flat attack damage bonus as well.
Ragnarok will not expire during Reckless Swing's cast time.
Ragnarok's duration will not be increased if the basic attack is dodged.
Ragnarok's duration will be increased if the basic attack is blocked.
